trefoil.name: Ur-Trefoil
trefoil.description: Complete aggregation of all 86 trefoil satellites (001‑086).
trefoil.best_for: Cosmic creation myths, meta‑canon establishment, universe source code, mathematical foundations.

trefoil_a.name: Canonical Trefoil
trefoil_a.description: Largest family (48 variants, 087‑134). Most mature, 'canonical' trefoil structure.
trefoil_a.best_for: Epic narratives, heroic journeys, cosmic myths, foundational stories.

trefoil_b.name: Canonical Trefoil
trefoil_b.description: Medium family (18 variants, 135‑152). 'Emerging' structures with invariant hexagon at lower weights.
trefoil_b.best_for: Coming‑of‑age stories, discovery‑focused narratives, exploration, first contact.

trefoil_c.name: Canonical Trefoil
trefoil_c.description: Large family (36 variants, 153‑188). Exceptionally strong coherence.
trefoil_c.best_for: Theological discourse, metaphysical inquiry, deep worldbuilding, philosophical fiction.

trefoil_d.name: Canonical Trefoil
trefoil_d.description: Large family (24 variants, 189‑212). Core‑centric with strong x→z but lighter peripheral connections.
trefoil_d.best_for: Character studies, memoirs, contemplative fiction, balanced reflective narratives.

trefoil_f.name: Canonical Trefoil
trefoil_f.description: Small family (4 variants, 213‑216). Invariant core: 8→y, b→a, d→c, f→e.
trefoil_f.best_for: Personal journeys, close relationships, interiority, intimate character‑focused narratives.

trefoil_g.name: Canonical Trefoil
trefoil_g.description: Large family (20 variants, 217‑236). Hierarchical merging from invariant skeleton to full connectivity.
trefoil_g.best_for: Rebellion, evolution, paradigm shifts, revolutionary narratives, transformation stories.

trefoil_h.name: Canonical Trefoil
trefoil_h.description: Small family (4 variants, 237‑240). Directed tree as 7‑node component.
trefoil_h.best_for: Parables, fables, allegories, symbolic tales, pure‑form narratives.

trefoil_i.name: Canonical Trefoil
trefoil_i.description: Chiral pair (2 variants, 241‑242). Persistent skeleton with 2‑2‑4‑4‑7 decomposition.
trefoil_i.best_for: Time‑travel stories, mirror‑worlds, duality, recursion, alternate timelines.

fig8.name: Canonical Trefoil
fig8.description: Hyperbolic family (3 variants, 243‑245). Persistent core: e→0.
fig8.best_for: Surreal fiction, dream‑logic, psychological horror, avant‑garde, weird fiction.

global.name: Global Aggregate
global.description: The complete aggregated adjacency over all 245 satellites.
global.best_for: Meta‑narratives, systems where all possible connections coexist, or when the precise stratum is deliberately unspecified.

constraint: A Factor must declare one stratum (or 'global') in its type_binding.usepong_binding.
